purpose: Teach the active governance outcome vocabulary as data submitted and processed by the option 000 demonstration.

manifest_label.title: Allowed
manifest_label.description: The canonical governance evaluation permits the candidate to proceed to any separately required commit/consequence checks.

manifest_label.title: Denied
manifest_label.description: The canonical governance evaluation rejects the candidate for the evaluated boundary.

manifest_label.title: Review required
manifest_label.description: The canonical governance evaluation requires a separate review or approval boundary before consequential continuation.

manifest_label.title: Fail closed
manifest_label.description: The system cannot establish the conditions required to continue and therefore blocks consequential continuation.

notes.ordering: governance_outcome_examples are intentionally prepended before the demo input so a human or LLM learns the outcome vocabulary before reading the example transaction.
notes.submission: Option 000 embeds this entire dataset as the governed demo manifest payload so the final runtime-bound output can prove which exact dataset was admitted and processed.
notes.scope: This dataset is for option 000 only. It is submitted as DATA and MUST NOT be treated as a user-authored manifest, a governance decision, or execution authority.
